name: useSend
description: useSend is an open-source email sending platform and self-hosted alternative to Resend, SendGrid or Postmark. It sends transactional email through a REST API, SDKs or SMTP and marketing campaigns from a visual editor, with tracking, bounce handling and webhooks, delivered through Amazon SES.

app_vars.name: var_github_id
app_vars.label: GitHub OAuth Client ID
app_vars.help: From a GitHub OAuth app whose callback URL is http://<container IP>:3000/api/auth/callback/github. Leave empty to configure it after the install; useSend starts once it is set.

notes.text: Sign-in is GitHub OAuth only, and the first sign-in claims the instance. Anyone with a GitHub account who reaches the port can do that, so sign in right after setting up OAuth.
Sending needs Amazon SES: set AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY in /opt/usesend_data/.env, then add SES under Admin with a callback URL reachable from the internet.
Behind a domain or after an IP change, update NEXTAUTH_URL in /opt/usesend_data/.env and the OAuth callback URL, then restart usesend.
